movies.webm is a 3-second silent solid-colour video generated for this repository's player tests with FFmpeg's color filter. It contains no third-party footage, music, images or other content. QCC dedicates the generated fixture to the public domain under CC0-1.0. It is test-only and is not shipped in public/ or the production build.

movies-hls-0.bin, movies-hls-1.bin and movies-hls-2.bin are MPEG-TS/H.264 segments generated from movies.webm for the relay player's HLS tests. They have the same CC0-1.0 provenance and remain test-only. Generated with: ffmpeg -i movies.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -preset veryfast -g 24 -keyint_min 24 -hls_time 1 -hls_playlist_type vod -hls_segment_filename movies-hls-%d.ts movies-hls.m3u8. The .bin suffix keeps TypeScript from treating the binary segments as source files.
